两问答案用 ==== 连接输出。", "canonical_answer": "[[EHGKXHKPSIME]]====[[TMYKPG]]", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "[[EWQTJCSYJRUP]]====[[KWVXEE]]", "certificate": "加密按 Reel1 至 Reel12 依次取环上后继：C→E、R→W、Y→Q、P→T、T→J、O→C、G→S、R→Y、A→J、P→R、H→U、Y→P，得到 EWQTJCSYJRUP。解密按 Reel1 至 Reel6 依次取环上前驱：Z→K、S→W、W→V、Z→X、M→E、T→E，得到 KWVXEE。"}]}
